mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ai_usage_log ( user_id, key_source, template_id, style, ai_type, model, question, knowledge_points, knowledge_base_ids, prompt, response, response_length, tokens_used, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_hit_tokens, cost, duration_ms, success, error_message, user_rating, user_feedback, create_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{keySource}, #{templateId}, #{style}, #{aiType}, #{model}, #{question}, #{knowledgePoints}, #{knowledgeBaseIds}, #{prompt}, #{response}, #{responseLength}, #{tokensUsed}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{cacheHitTokens}, #{cost}, #{durationMs}, #{success}, #{errorMessage}, #{userRating}, #{userFeedback}, #{createTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 0) FROM t_ai_usage_log
SELECT style, COUNT(*) as count FROM t_ai_usage_log GROUP BY style ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS requestCount, SUM(IFNULL(tokens_used, 0)) AS tokensUsed, SUM(IFNULL(cost, 0)) AS cost, SUM(CASE WHEN success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successCount, SUM(CASE WHEN success = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failedCount, AVG(IFNULL(duration_ms, 0)) AS avgDurationMs FROM t_ai_usage_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)

SELECT key_source AS keySource, COUNT(*) AS requestCount, SUM(IFNULL(tokens_used, 0)) AS tokensUsed, SUM(IFNULL(cost, 0)) AS cost, SUM(CASE WHEN success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successCount, SUM(CASE WHEN success = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failedCount, AVG(IFNULL(duration_ms, 0)) AS avgDurationMs FROM t_ai_usage_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY key_source

SELECT ai_type AS provider, model, COUNT(*) AS requestCount, SUM(IFNULL(tokens_used, 0)) AS tokensUsed, SUM(IFNULL(cost, 0)) AS cost, SUM(CASE WHEN success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successCount FROM t_ai_usage_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY ai_type, model ORDER BY requestCount DESC

SELECT id, key_source AS keySource, style AS taskType, ai_type AS provider, model, LEFT(question, 80) AS question, tokens_used AS tokensUsed, cache_hit_tokens AS cacheHitTokens, input_tokens AS inputTokens, output_tokens AS outputTokens, cost, duration_ms AS durationMs, success, LEFT(error_message, 100) AS errorMessage, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime FROM t_ai_usage_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
